units.summary: Adds a test-only struct type holding input, expected Quantity and expected canonical string. It replaces the anonymous table struct inside TestQuantityParse and has no production effect.
units.headline: Test table struct gains expectString field
units.reason: Test-only type declaration used by the reworked parse tests and benchmarks; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: The parse table becomes a function returning a fresh slice, with an expected canonical string added to each case. It is shared by the parse tests and the benchmarks. The new expected strings follow canonical Quantity formatting and are checked against ParseQuantity caching.
units.headline: Parse test table becomes function with expected strings
units.reason: Test-only data refactor with new assertions on canonical strings; no existing expectations were weakened.

units.summary: The benchmark is rewritten to use b.Loop and per-quantity sub-benchmarks over the shared test cases. It is benchmark-only code and does not run in normal tests.
units.headline: Benchmark converted to sub-benchmarks using b.Loop
units.reason: Benchmark-only change that cannot affect production behavior.
